python3 -c 'import importlib.util, subprocess, json, pathlib, hashlib, re
lane = "/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin"
clone = "/fast/scratch/hyaku/tameshi-r57/T57W3Read17/clone"
rev = "adf87899c70d616140a81185a8f9acbbdfb30392"

m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
raw = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", lane, "show", rev + ":SKILL.md"])
sec = next(s for s in m.sectionize(raw) if s["heading"] == "### Round-21 gate/probe registry — finite environment differential")
print("SECTION", sec["start"], sec["end"], sec["sha256"])
text = "\n".join(raw.decode().splitlines()[sec["start"]-1:sec["end"]])
paths = sorted(set(re.findall(r"(?:\.ufo/[\w./-]+|(?:corpus|tools)/[\w./-]+)", text)))
paths += [".ufo/evidence/round-24/extra-cases.json", ".ufo/evidence/round-23/replay.py", ".ufo/evidence/round-21/coldread/ledger.json"]
for p in paths: print("POINTER", p, pathlib.Path(clone,p).exists())
for p in [".ufo/evidence/round-21/c1-survivors.py", ".ufo/evidence/round-21/c2-count.py", ".ufo/evidence/round-21/c1-mutants.json", ".ufo/evidence/round-21/c2-contract.json"]:
 old=subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",clone,"show","33d03b7:"+p]); now=pathlib.Path(clone,p).read_bytes()
 print("UNCHANGED_FROM_33d03b7",p,old==now,hashlib.sha256(now).hexdigest())
ledger=json.loads(pathlib.Path(clone,".ufo/evidence/round-21/coldread/ledger.json").read_bytes())
print("LEDGER_SHAPE",type(ledger).__name__,len(ledger))
for p in [".ufo/evidence/round-21/c2-contract.json", ".ufo/evidence/round-21/f5/receipt.json", ".ufo/waves/round-21/routemix-spec1.json"]:
 data=json.loads(pathlib.Path(clone,p).read_bytes())
 if "surfaces" in data: print("POPULATION",p,len(data["surfaces"]))
 if "required_profiles" in data: print("PROFILES",len(data["required_profiles"]))
 if "ok" in data: print("RETAINED_ROUTE_OK",data["ok"])
registry=json.loads(pathlib.Path(clone,"tools/registry.json").read_bytes())
for row in registry["rows"]:
 if row["name"] in ["command-binding-selftest", "command-binding-selftest-r24", "command-binding-frozen-clean-pinned", "command-binding-source-read-red-pinned", "registry-replay-selftest"]: print("REGISTRY",json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True))
